description: This file is a unit test for the JsonPointerInvalidException class in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It tests the behavior of the exception when constructed with a JSON pointer string containing consecutive slashes.

classes.name: JsonPointerInvalidExceptionTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing JsonPointerInvalidException behavior.

methods.name: testNewBuilderForConsecutiveSlashes
methods.description: Tests the creation of a JsonPointerInvalidException using the builder method for consecutive slashes and verifies the exception message and description.
